title: Week 19 - Plugin Archives, Command History Search, Worktree Control
description: Load plugins from .zip archives and URLs, search command history across every project with Ctrl+R, branch new worktrees from local HEAD or remote default, and block actions unconditionally with auto mode hard deny rules. Hooks now receive effort level via environment variables.

community_feedback.quote: What are the best Claude Code plugins right now? Does anyone have recommendations for Oh-My-Claudecode, Claude-Mem, Awesome-Claude-Code?
Claude cli is also a much better user experience than codex cli. But Codex gets complex things right more consistently.
Agent-browser uses 82-93% less context tokens according to recent analysis of 78 Reddit threads, 76 X posts, 22 YouTube videos, and 15 HN stories.

title: Codex CLI 0.129.0 and Chrome Extension
description: New Codex CLI version 0.129.0 with modal Vim editing in composer, improved TUI workflows, theme-aware status line, plugin workspace sharing, and enhanced hooks. Also introduced Codex for Chrome extension for working with apps and websites in the browser.

title: Windsurf 2.2.17 - Devin Review & Quick Review
description: All Windsurf IDE users now have access to Devin Review and Quick Review with existing subscription. Added Agent Command Center improvements including list display option and improved sessions sidebar. Fixed bugs with MCP servers and improved Devin Local agent reliability.

community_feedback.quote: We just shipped Devin Review and Quick Review in Windsurf - you can use that page to report bugs and suggest new features.
Users report confusion around the Codeium → Windsurf rebrand and confusion about the upcoming Devin integration.

title: PR Review, Parallel Build Plans, and Split PRs
description: New PR review experience with inline threads, commits tab, and changes picker. Parallel execution on plans using async subagents. Quick-action pills for common workflows. Team marketplace updates, security review beta, model access controls, and soft spend limits for enterprise.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor reached over 1 million users and 360,000 paying customers in just 16 months.
Cursor 3.0 launched April 2, 2026 with parallel agents and Design Mode - significant improvements to the development experience.

title: Copilot CLI May Update and Model Deprecations
description: Path completion improvements in /add-dir, slash commands can now appear mid-input, and bug fixes. Announced deprecation of Grok Code Fast 1, GPT-5.2, and GPT-5.2-Codex models. Copilot code review comment types now in usage metrics API.

community_feedback.quote: Starting June 1, 2026, GitHub is moving Copilot from request-based billing to usage-based billing - users would naturally be a little upset.
GitHub Copilot's shift to a paid model exposes the 'biggest lie' in developer tools pricing.

title: Gemini CLI v0.40.0 - Offline Search and Advanced Resource Management
description: Bundled ripgrep for offline search support and added GitHub-style colorblind themes. Introduced MCP resource tools and transitioned to a prompt-driven, four-tier memory management system. Enabled topic update narrations by default and streamlined Gemma local model setup.
